HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   C. Explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Human developmen ts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Say Human developmen ts in Africa never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about External Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing External Security.

   D. Treat External Security as rumours only.

   A. Say Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya.
   C. Treat Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

9. Which statement about Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Human developmen ts in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain African Civilisations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
